purpose: Test whether context-specific functional contribution geometry improves fixed-source native group transfer and new-context actual operations beyond same-input Euclidean, amplitude and shuffled-response controls.
scope: Retained exposed natural development, same 24 source-only anchors and Euclidean-coarsened source gates, same target128 pools, one controlled seed edge and two mechanisms. Pointwise Fisher uses model-distribution score samples on discovery; source and target gates are native nonnegative deletion fractions. Same-row Euclidean, pointwise, shuffled-response and amplitude controls receive identical source operation and target pool. Actual model ablations on calibration remain development, with next-token response secondary and not independent causal semantics. No new dataset, seed, or main-conference claim.
